title: LRU
statementMd:
While creating high loaded systems one should pay a special attention to caching. This problem will be about one of the most popular caching algorithms called LRU (Least Recently Used).

Suppose the cache may store no more than $*k*$ objects. At the beginning of the workflow the cache is empty. When some object is queried we check if it is present in the cache and move it here if it's not. If there are more than $*k*$ objects in the cache after this, the least recently used one should be removed. In other words, we remove the object that has the smallest time of the last query.

Consider there are $*n*$ videos being stored on the server, all of the same size. Cache can store no more than $*k*$ videos and caching algorithm described above is applied. We know that any time a user enters the server he pick the video $*i*$ with probability $*p*_{*i*}$. The choice of the video is independent to any events before.

The goal of this problem is to count for each of the videos the probability it will be present in the cache after $10^{100}$ queries.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 20$) — the number of videos and the size of the cache respectively. Next line contains $*n*$ real numbers $*p*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1$), each of them is given with no more than two digits after decimal point.

It's guaranteed that the sum of all $*p*_{*i*}$ is equal to $1$.

## Output

Print $*n*$ real numbers, the $*i*$-th of them should be equal to the probability that the $*i*$-th video will be present in the cache after $10^{100}$ queries. You answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).
statementZhMd:
在创建高负载系统时，应特别关注缓存问题。本题将讨论一种最常用的缓存算法之一：LRU（Least Recently Used，最近最少使用）。

假设缓存最多可以存储 $*k*$ 个对象。在工作开始时，缓存为空。当查询某个对象时，我们检查它是否存在于缓存中；如果不存在，就将其加入缓存。如果此后缓存中的对象数超过 $*k*$，则应移除最近最少使用的对象。换句话说，我们会移除最后一次被查询的时间最早的对象。

现有 $*n*$ 个存储在服务器上的视频，它们的大小均相同。缓存最多可以存储 $*k*$ 个视频，并应用上述缓存算法。

已知每当用户访问服务器时，他会以概率 $*p*_{*i*}$ 选择视频 $*i*$。视频的选择与之前发生的任何事件相互独立。

本题的目标是计算对于每个视频，在经过 $10^{100}$ 次查询后该视频仍存在于缓存中的概率。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 20$），分别表示视频数量和缓存大小。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个实数 $*p*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1$），每个数的小数部分不超过两位。

保证所有 $*p*_{*i*}$ 之和等于 $1$。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个实数，其中第 $*i*$ 个数应等于经过 $10^{100}$ 次查询后第 $*i*$ 个视频存在于缓存中的概率。如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测答案为 $*b*$。如果满足以下条件，校验程序会认为你的答案正确：[image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png)。
